title: ScriptBundle
description: One captured npm lifecycle script. Bytes are referenced by hash; never execute the script on the host.

package_name.description: npm package name, including scope if present

integrity.description: Subresource integrity string from the lockfile (e.g. sha512-...)

source_path.description: Path inside the extracted tarball or inline:package.json

inline_command.description: Raw package.json scripts.<hook> string when the hook is a shell command

parent_chain.description: Dependency parents from the lockfile, root last or documented order
